type.name: alpha
type.description: ASCII string, null-terminated when the fixed length is not fully used. The first byte contains a null if the field is unused. Length specified per field. The SDK strips the terminator on decode and pads with NUL on encode.

type.name: byte
type.description: Single byte used to hold one ASCII character.

type.name: bitfield
type.description: Single byte where individual bits carry meaning. Bit 0 is the least significant bit, bit 7 the most significant.

type.name: uint64
type.description: Unsigned 64-bit little-endian integer. Java has no unsigned 64-bit primitive: all 64 bits are preserved in a long, but a value above 2^63-1 reads as negative. Use Long.toUnsignedString and Long.compareUnsigned when that is possible. C# and C++ expose it as a true unsigned type.

type.name: price4
type.description: Signed 32-bit little-endian integer with 4 implied decimal places (divide by 10000).

type.name: price8
type.description: Signed 64-bit little-endian integer with 8 implied decimal places (divide by 100000000).

field.name: executionType
field.description: 0 = New, 4 = Cancelled, 5 = Modified, 8 = Rejected, 9 = Suspended, A = Pending New, C = Expired, D = Restated, E = Pending Replace, F = Trade, H = Trade Cancel, L = Triggered

value.meaning: New - Indicates that a new order or quote side has been accepted.
Cancelled - Indicates that a cancel request has been accepted and successfully processed.
Modified - Indicates that an order modification request has been accepted and successfully processed.
Rejected - Indicates that an order or quote side has been rejected. The reason for the rejection is specified in the field Reject Code .
Suspended - Indicates that an order that was in the main container has been parked and is no longer available for execution.
Pending New - Indicates that a new order or quote side has been forwarded to the risk management system for validation.
Expired - An order or quote side has expired in terms of its time qualifier, execution limit and expired based on the cancel on disconnect feature.
Restated - Indicates an order or quote side has been modified by the service desk or automatically re-priced by the system.
Pending Replace - Indicates that a new order or quote side has been forwarded to the risk management system for validation.
Trade - Indicates that an order or quote side has been partially or fully filled. The execution details (e.g. side, price and quantity) are specified.
Trade Cancel - Indicates that an execution has been cancelled. The Execution ID of the execution being cancelled will be included.
Triggered - Indicates that a parked ATC, GFA, OPG or contingent order (i.e. stop, stop limit) has been activated and moved to the main container.
